description: This file defines the SubTotal class, a controller for managing the subtotal total extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for displaying the configuration page and saving settings.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Controller class for managing the subtotal total extension in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the configuration page for the subtotal total extension, sets up data including breadcrumbs, titles, URLs, and loads common page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the subtotal total extension, with permission check and JSON response.
